name: You are an award-winning creative developer

messages.content:
You are an award-winning creative developer and art director. Build an unforgettable, vibrant, creative personal portfolio website for me. It must look like it was designed by a top studio and win design awards, NOT like a template. Mobile-first and fully responsive. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript (GSAP with ScrollTrigger via CDN is allowed; otherwise no heavy dependencies), deployable for free on GitHub Pages or Vercel. At the end, give a short README with file structure, local run and deployment steps.

## About me (use ONLY this information)
- Name: Amir Girgis Mofid
- Headline: Software Development Student (C# / ASP.NET Core) | Digital Marketing & AI Automation | Founder, Market Sphere X
- Location: Giza, Egypt
- Contact: amirgargas28@gmail.com | +20 122 364 6440 | linkedin.com/in/amir-girgis-9392aa340 | github.com/amir-girgis
- Summary: Software development student at EVA International School of Applied Technology (Technical Diploma in Software Development, expected 2027), studying through a USAID-supported scholarship. Founder & Team Leader of Market Sphere X Agency (digital marketing, branding, web development, AI automation, since March 2024). Passionate about entrepreneurship, technology, youth empowerment and international cooperation.

## Sections (in this order)
1. Hero: huge creative typographic intro with my name and headline, my photo, and buttons "VIEW WORK", "DOWNLOAD CV" (link to /Amir_Girgis_CV.pdf), "CONTACT ME".
2. About: a large statement sentence with highlighted keywords, plus a bento grid of tiles: 60+ students mentored, 11 clients, 1st Place INNOVET III 2026, TechSkills Forum 2026 winner, Giza Egypt with a live "CAIRO" clock, current focus.
3. Experience:
   - Founder & Team Leader, Market Sphere X Agency (March 2024 – Present): leads a cross-functional team (web development, graphic design, video production, photography, AI automation, business development, sales); delivers websites, branding, social media strategy and AI workflow automation for clients, mainly real estate companies in Egypt. Team size: [TEAM_SIZE]. Clients: 11.
   - School Ambassador, PHP Team Leader, Peer Assistant and Student Professional Mentor at EVA: supports 60+ students in technical and professional development.
4. Projects (large cards with number, category, short description, tool tags):
   - AI Lead Qualification Platform: pipeline integrating Claude AI, Make, Airtable and Telegram via webhooks that scores and routes inbound leads, syncs CRM data and generates proposals/emails with one human approval step.
   - SAKAN (tagline "Your Life, Your Way."): a student-focused platform CONCEPT for students living away from their families, combining accommodation discovery and booking, study management, personal finance management, daily life organization and a proposed AI assistant. My role: concept and value proposition, audience analysis, digital marketing strategy, brand identity, social media campaigns, Instagram posts/stories/reels content, digital presence and final presentation. Do NOT claim I developed the app's software. Won 1st place at INNOVET III.
   - A placeholder card "More projects coming soon" (no fake projects).
5. Achievements & Awards:
   - 1st Place – Digital Marketing Competition, INNOVET III – TVET ReAImagined Innovation Summit (November 9, 2026). Organized by Egypt's Ministry of Education and Technical Education with GIZ, the European Union and the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation. Team: Amir Girgis, Keroles Ayman, Ahmed Adel, Mina Sameh. Make this the most eye-catching element on the page.
   - Winner, "Discovering" Challenge, TechSkills Forum 2026 (Mediterranean TVET Forum, inaugural edition, New Administrative Capital, Egypt), representing Egypt on an international team from Mediterranean countries. Dates: [TECHSKILLS_DATES].
6. Volunteering: Volunteer, Global Entrepreneurship Festival (GEF) 2026, Cairo, November 6–8, 2026, Digital Marketing team. Supported investors in the Deals Room: explained projects, scheduled meetings, took notes, translated English–Arabic, helped assess each project's strengths and risks, and recorded in the event form whether a project reached a deal. Received an official Volunteer Certificate.
7. Skills (grouped tag chips, NO progress bars or percentages):
   - Backend: C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, MVC, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, SQL Server
   - AI & Automation: Claude, ChatGPT, Prompt Engineering, Make, REST APIs, Webhooks
   - Frontend & Design: HTML, CSS, Figma
   - Tools: Git, GitHub, Visual Studio
   - Digital Marketing: Strategy, Market Research, Target Audience Analysis, Social Media Marketing, Content Strategy, Campaign Planning, SEO
   - Brand & Creative: Brand Identity, Creative Direction, Visual Communication
   - Professional: Team Leadership, Collaboration, Presentation, Problem Solving
8. Education: Technical Diploma in Software Development, EVA International School of Applied Technology (expected 2027).
9. Contact: a giant "LET'S BUILD SOMETHING IMPACTFUL" headline, big pill buttons for email, LinkedIn and GitHub, plus a simple form that opens the visitor's mail app (mailto), no backend.

## Art direction: "Sunset Pop"
Concept: warm, energetic, optimistic, cinematic. A young founder-builder with a loud but polished personality. Think vivid gradient light, soft glass surfaces and huge confident typography.

Palette (vibrant, high-impact):
- Background: warm white #FFF8F2
- Ink: #14112B (deep indigo-black for text and dark sections)
- Hot Magenta #FF2E93
- Sunset Orange #FF8A00
- Electric Blue #3A5BFF
- Sun Yellow #FFD23F (tiny highlights and stickers only)
- Signature gradient: Electric Blue → Hot Magenta → Sunset Orange, used for hero glow, buttons, highlights and the INNOVET card.
Dark mode toggle: ink background #0E0B22 with the same vivid gradient glows.

Typography:
- Display: ultra-bold, tight and oversized (Bricolage Grotesque or Unbounded ExtraBold), with line-height 0.9, mixing solid and outline-only words in the same headline.
- Body: Inter. Labels and tags: JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracked out.
- Section header: small mono eyebrow with a gradient line ("01 — ABOUT"), then a giant heading and a faint oversized outline number.

Signature creative elements:
- Hero background: a large, softly animated gradient mesh/blobs (CSS or lightweight canvas) that slowly moves; my portrait (assets/amir.jpg) in an arch mask with a glowing gradient ring; rotating circular text badge ("AVAILABLE FOR OPPORTUNITIES • FOUNDER • DEVELOPER •"); floating glass chips ("C# / ASP.NET CORE", "DIGITAL MARKETING", "FOUNDER, MARKET SPHERE X") with parallax.
- Glassmorphism cards (blur, thin white border, soft shadow) over gradient backgrounds, with 28px rounded corners.
- Highlighted keywords inside big sentences using gradient-filled text or a hand-drawn marker underline.
- Marquee bands of my real keywords (C#, ASP.NET CORE, DIGITAL MARKETING, AI AUTOMATION, WEB DEVELOPMENT, LEADERSHIP, ENTREPRENEURSHIP) between sections, in alternating directions, with gradient and ink backgrounds.
- Projects: large cards, each with its own gradient mood, big numbers, tags and pill buttons; stacked-cards-on-scroll on desktop, simple vertical cards on mobile.
- INNOVET III spotlight: a full-width gradient card with a "1ST PLACE" sticker badge, a slow shine animation and a confetti-like particle burst once when it enters the viewport (subtle, under 2 seconds).
- Experience and Volunteering: a timeline with glowing gradient nodes.
- Footer: giant outlined name, live "CAIRO" clock, "BACK TO TOP".
- Floating pill-shaped navigation with glass effect (top on desktop, bottom on mobile) and a theme toggle.
- A fast name-reveal loader (under 1.2 seconds, skippable).

Motion (cinematic but smooth):
- Staggered hero text entrance, scroll-triggered reveals with ScrollTrigger, text-split headline animations, magnetic hover on buttons, tilt/lift on cards, parallax on floating elements, animated counters ONLY for confirmed facts (60+, 11, 1st place), and a custom blend-mode cursor on desktop only.
- Keep it fast on phones: transform and opacity only, no heavy canvas on mobile (use static gradient), respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Strict design rules:
- No stock photos, no skill progress bars, no emoji decoration, no purple-on-white "generic AI" look, no clutter. Strong hierarchy, generous spacing, consistent grid and alignment. Make sure text over gradients keeps WCAG AA contrast.

## My photo
- My photo is at assets/amir.jpg. Use it in the Hero and About sections with object-fit: cover, descriptive alt text ("Portrait of Amir Girgis Mofid"), lazy-loading for the About version, and a fallback initials avatar ("AG") if the image fails to load.
- Do not edit my face or generate a different image of me.

## Quality requirements
- Semantic HTML, WCAG AA contrast, alt text, keyboard navigation, visible focus states.
- SEO: title, meta description, Open Graph tags, JSON-LD Person schema, favicon.
- Performance: Lighthouse 90+, no layout shift, minimal JavaScript, lazy-loaded images, subsetted fonts.
- English only.

## Strict content rules
- Do NOT invent metrics, testimonials, client names, certifications, projects, dates or job duties that are not listed above.
- Keep ALL text in one data file (content.js or data.json) so I can edit it without touching the layout.
- Put [TEAM_SIZE] and [TECHSKILLS_DATES] as clearly marked, editable placeholders in that file and list them at the end of your answer.

Deliver the complete working code, then the README.
